sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Ultra-HD 4K Minimally Invasive Rigid Endoscopes

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law legal system with North American commercial law influence; unitary national regime; no sub-state tax distinction.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 31 October 2012; includes investment chapter)
Panama–Spain Agreement for the Reciprocal Promotion and Protection of Investments (in force since 2000)
Panama–Netherlands Double Taxation Agreement (signed 2011, effective as from 2012)
Panama–Qatar Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 2018, subject to ratification/entry-into-force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (Panama's unified AML/CFT law), as amended and supplemented by implementing regulations and directives issued by the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros (SSNF), the Financial Analysis Unit (UAF), and the Registro Público de Panamá for beneficial ownership information collection.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of the foreign parent entity (or, if unincorporated, equivalent corporate existence evidence)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or competent corporate authority of the parent entity's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the issuing state is party to the Apostille Convention; otherwise Panamanian consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized shareholder or board resolution approving the incorporation of the Panamanian S.A. and capital structure
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public / corporate secretary of the foreign parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Panamanian consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney granted to the local resident agent / incorporating counsel (Poder Especial)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the beneficiary owner's jurisdiction; countersigned by a Panamanian Consul when non-Hague legalization applies
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Panamanian consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport copies and proof of residential address for each ultimate beneficial owner, director and officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or licensed certifying authority in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Panamanian consular legalization for foreign-certified copies

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Where applicable, ISO 13485 certificate or product safety certificate supporting the medical device manufacturing scope
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Accredited certification body in the manufacturing jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Panamanian consular legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, principal officers and counterparties against Panama's UAF watchlist, OFAC SDN list, United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and domestic panama PEP database. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons, including those holding office within the last 12 months; source-of-funds documentation must be obtained for each qualifying UBO before incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas Jurídicas / Sistema de Reserva de Nombres (online name clearance and reservation portal of the Public Registry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official working language is Spanish; corporate names are accepted in Latin script. A name in non-Latin characters requires a sworn Spanish transliteration at the time of registration. The corporate suffix 'S.A.', 'Corp.' or approved equivalent must be included.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended for one additional 30-day term if requested before expiry. If the Registro Público rejects a proposed name, the applicant may file a written reconsideration request (recurso de reconsideración) within five working days of notification. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may pursue an administrative contentious appeal (demanda contencioso-administrativa) before the Sala Tercera de la Corte Suprema de Justicia, supported by legal arguments and evidence of non-confusing distinctiveness.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or registered-agent address is permissible for the corporate seat during incorporation. However, for an ISIC 3250 / NAICS 339112 manufacturer of surgical laparoscopy towers, the health regulatory authority (MINSA) and the customs and circuit board tax authority require a physical establishment, storage or production facility evidence before issuing the sanitary operation permit; therefore, a purely virtual office will not satisfy operating-license substance requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 45% quantified likelihood of an unannounced pre-permit site inspection by MINSA/DIGESA once the sanitary application is filed; 25% additional probability of periodic random inspection after license issuance for a medical device manufacturing entity.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and reservation certificate (Certificado de Búsqueda de Nombre)
Notarization of incorporation deed before a Panamanian Notary Public
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff and prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company registration and inscription fee at the Public Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official registry tariff for Sociedad Anónima formation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RUC / fiscal identification registration and issuance of corporate tax ID
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration fee plus administrative handling

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration filing to the beneficial ownership registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Público de Panamá / delegated registry agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office service (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Panamanian licensed law firm / resident agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for S.A. maintenance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and/or consular legalization of foreign corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Panamanian Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular or apostille fee schedule plus courier

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of incorporation and UBO supporting documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per bilingual notarized document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC due diligence file preparation, PEP and sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional legal fee for structured corporate KYC

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 (Sociedades Anónimas), as amended by Ley 5 de 1998, Articles 2–15 (incorporation, share capital, directors); supplementary application of the Código de Comercio de Panamá; Ley 70 de 2018 (mandatory Beneficial Ownership Registry filing for all legal entities).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry of Panama) – Dirección General de Registro, Sección de Registro Mercantil / Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima (notarized Public Deed of Incorporation) together with the Pacto Social y Estatutos, presented via a licensed Panamanian attorney or registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement under Panamanian law. The Articles of Incorporation must state the authorized capital (customarily USD 10,000 divided into 100 registered shares of USD 100 each); subscribers must take at least one share, and capital may be paid in whole or in part as determined by the board.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BE IT RESOLVED, FIRST: That the subscriptions to the Company's shares, as recorded in the Articles of Incorporation, are hereby ratified, accepted, and allotted to the respective subscribers. SECOND: That the registered office of the Company, located in the Republic of Panama, as stated in the Articles, is hereby approved and confirmed, and the licensed Resident Agent continues in office. THIRD: That the following directors and officers are appointed: President, Secretary, and Treasurer, each empowered to act singly within their corporate offices. FOURTH: That the President and Treasurer are authorized, jointly or singly, to open bank accounts, sign commercial instruments, procure manufacturing licenses and permits, and engage counsel to complete all registrations necessary to commence operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Search and Availability Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Dirección de Registro Mercantil (online via the Registro Público en Línea portal).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two priority name proposals through the Public Registry's online query system and pay the search fee to obtain an availability certificate confirming that the proposed corporate name (e.g., Laparoscopy Towers Panama, S.A. or a similar trade name) is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity. The registered name must include the words 'Sociedad Anónima' or the abbreviation 'S.A.'.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID copy of each subscriber
Payment receipt for name search fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar, refile with the alternative name; if the second refusal persists, submit a written reconsideration request to the Public Registry supported by a memorandum distinguishing the corporate object and trade field.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Incorporation Power of Attorney (Poder) and Drafting of Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública del Circuito de Panamá (Notary Public of the Judicial Circuit of Panama).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Each subscriber appears before the Notary and executes a special power of attorney (Poder) in favor of a licensed Panamanian attorney or registered agent for the purpose of subscribing and executing the incorporation deed. Concurrently, the attorney drafts the Pacto Social y Estatutos stating the corporate name, corporate object (manufacture of Ultra-HD 4K rigid endoscopes and minimally invasive surgical laparoscopy towers), authorized capital, share classes, board composition, and resident agent clause.
required_dossiers: Passport or cédula copies of all subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary identifies defects in identification, capacity, or authority, correct and re-execute the Poder before the same or another Notary; delays are mitigated by including substitution powers in the original Poder.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Public Deed of Incorporation and Fiscal Stamp Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública del Circuito de Panamá; Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – fiscal stamp collection.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The authorized attorney executes the Escritura Pública de Constitución before the Notary, incorporating the full bylaws by reference or transcription. Upon execution, pay notarial fees and the applicable impuesto de timbres (fiscal stamps / notarial folios) at an authorized bank or the DGI; obtain the stamped notarial folios required for registration. The deed must record each subscriber's name, the shares subscribed, the authorized capital, the first directors, and the resident agent.
required_dossiers: Fiscal stamps / notarial folio payment receipt
Valid identification of the incorporating attorney and witnesses
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notarized deed contains a clerical or substantive error, execute a clarifying amendment (aclaración) before the same Notary prior to registry submission, and re-pay stamp fees only for spoiled folios.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Deed in the Public Registry of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Registro Mercantil / Sociedades.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Escritura Pública de Constitución with the Mercantile Registration Division together with authenticated copies and fee receipts for inscription. The Registry examines the deed for compliance with Ley 32 de 1927 and issues the registered certificate (certificado de inscripción) with a folio number. Faster turnaround may be obtained through the Public Registry's express service (registro express).
required_dossiers: Original notarized public deed of incorporation
Certified fiscal stamp and notarial folio receipts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues an observation (nota de observación), correct each cited deficiency through a clarifying deed, pay any supplementary stamp tax, and refile; if a priority deadline is at risk, re-present the corrected deed under the express service.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Registrations (RUC, Municipal Aviso de Operación, and Social Security)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministry of Economy and Finance; Municipality of Panama – Dirección de Avisos de Operación; Caja de Seguro Social (CSS).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receipt of the registration certificate, apply to DGI for the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes); file the Aviso de Operación with the Municipality of Panama for the industrial manufacturing activity; register as an employer with CSS for payroll and occupational risk coverage; and submit the initial premises declaration (declaración de actividad) identifying the manufacturing location.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation from the Public Registry
Valid ID of the legal representative (President or Secretary)
Lease contract or ownership title of the manufacturing premises
Completed DGI, municipal, and CSS application forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Municipality questions the industrial zoning classification, submit the zoning-use certificate (certificado de uso de suelo) issued by the Municipality's planning department; for DGI or CSS queries, respond in writing with corrected forms and supporting documentation within the granted term.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Beneficial Ownership Filing and Resident Agent Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) – Dirección de Beneficiarios Finales; Registro Público de Panamá (Resident Agent desk).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of incorporation, file the Declaración de Beneficiario Final under Ley 70 de 2018 identifying every natural person who ultimately owns or controls more than 10% of the shares or exercises control over the company. Confirm the resident agent's acceptance with the Public Registry and open the corporate minute book and share register, stamping all share certificates for issuance to subscribers.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the incorporation certificate
Resident agent and registered agent acceptance letters
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late filing of the beneficial ownership declaration triggers statutory fines; remedy by immediate electronic filing and submission of a written excusal request (solicitud de exoneración) to MEF, attaching evidence of force majeure or good faith compliance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) – Dirección Nacional de Empresas y Regulación; Municipality of Panama – Dirección de Avisos de Operación (industrial zoning); Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) – Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Dispositivos Médicos (sanitary registration of medical devices).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (Municipal Industrial Operating Notice) – Manufacture of Medical Devices; supplementary Registro Sanitario de Dispositivos Médicos (MINSA sanitary registration for commercial distribution and export of Ultra-HD 4K rigid endoscopes); MICI industrial classification and business registration certification.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Evaluación y Control Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II (moderate impact under the Resolución AG-0213-2000 classification schedule) – requires a Diagnóstico Ambiental de Impacto (DAI) with a compliance commitment; full Category I EIA is not required for clean electronic/optical assembly; a pre-operation environmental permit (Permiso de Operación Ambiental) is mandatory before production start.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must meet national maximum permissible limits (pH 6–9; BOD5 ≤ 100 mg/L; total suspended solids ≤ 100 mg/L) with no direct surface-water discharge absent a separate permit; volatile organic compound emissions from cleaning and soldering operations must be controlled below occupational exposure limits (e.g., 50 ppm for isopropanol) using approved ventilation; electronic waste, used fluorescent tubes, and chemical containers must be disposed through MiAMBIENTE-authorized facilities with retained manifests.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá fire-safety inspection certificate (Sello de Inspección y Seguridad); Municipality of Panama structural load and building occupancy clearance for the manufacturing premises; Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) workplace hygiene and occupational risk plan approval; Caja de Seguro Social employer registration for occupational injury coverage and mandatory life insurance for exposed workers.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), part of the Ministry of Economy and Finance (Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas), official portal www.dgi.gob.pa
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must appoint a licensed Panamanian resident agent and registered legal counsel, then file an application with the DGI using the company's public deed, certificate of incorporation, and proof of appointment of directors/officers. The DGI issues a provisional RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) followed by a definitive RUC after verification of the registered office, beneficial ownership and compliance with Law 41 / AML due diligence. All filings may be completed electronically through the DGI online portal, with authentication by the resident agent's digital signature.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No OECD-style check-the-box regime exists. A Panamanian S.A. may elect into the small taxpayer simplified net-estimated-income regime; qualified entities may apply for the SEM (Multinational Company Headquarters) preferential regime, Panama Pacifico Special Economic Area benefits, or tourism development incentives. Hybrid mismatch elections are unavailable because Panama adheres to BEPS minimum standards; a standard S.A. is taxed at entity level on Panama-source income and cannot elect pass-through taxation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Corporales Muebles y Servicios)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general economic threshold; any person supplying taxable goods or services in Panama must obtain a RUC and register for ITBMS. A simplified small-taxpayer regime is available for annual taxable turnover of up to PAB 300,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Registered taxpayers must issue all invoices through DGI-authorised electronic billing (facturación electrónica) software, using DGI-validated digital certificates and a fiscal QR stamp. Invoices and credit/debit notes for goods and services must be transmitted to the DGI portal in real-time or near-real-time batches; customs export invoices must be cross-linked with the electronic customs declaration (eDUA/SIUCA) and are subject to digital clearance validation at the port of exit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rated ITBMS (0%) applies on the supply of tangible goods sold to a non-resident customer where the goods are physically exported from Panama within the ordinary statutory period (generally 60 days from invoicing). Services qualify when provided to a non-resident and the benefit is wholly consumed outside Panama, excluding services related to Panamanian real estate. The exporter must hold documentary evidence proving actual exit of goods or offshore use of services, and comply with any DGI ruling or prior-authorisation requirement. Services provided to licensed SEM (Multinational Company Headquarters) companies may also qualify as exported services.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (eDUA/SIUCA) showing goods actually departed the Panamanian customs territory
Bill of Lading, airway bill or combined transport document issued to the foreign buyer
Inward Remittance Certificate or equivalent bank confirmation of the export proceeds
Commercial invoice marked 'Exportación Cero por Ciento' / 'Zero-Rated Export'
Packing list and certificate of origin, if applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI may require exporters to substantiate each zero-rated invoice with customs and banking records. Failure to prove actual export or any misrepresentation triggers immediate disallowance of the zero rate, reassessment of ITBMS at 7%, plus compensatory interest and a fine generally ranging from 50% to 100% of the omitted tax. Fraudulent zero-rating claims may constitute criminal tax fraud punishable by imprisonment and additional penalties. The standard five-year assessment period is extended in cases of fraud or non-filing. Panama does not operate a statutory FX repatriation deadline; the 180-day parameter is applied as an administrative reasonableness benchmark for reconciling export proceeds, with bank records accepted as remittance evidence.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: None; the Republic of Panama is fully dollarized and does not maintain a central bank. Banking and financial regulation are vested in the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP), while AML/CFT supervision is exercised by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) under Ley 23 de 2015.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility with no exchange-control regime. The US Dollar (USD) is legal tender; the Panamanian Balboa (PAB) exists only as coinage pegged 1:1 to USD. Both current-account and capital-account transactions are unrestricted, and no prior approval, license, or declaration is required for inward or outward transfers. Profit remittance hurdles are limited to Panamanian tax compliance rather than FX authorization: dividends sourced in Panama are subject to a dividend withholding tax (generally 10%, with the underlying corporate income tax creditable in the hands of the shareholder in certain integrated structures, and reduced rates under specific legal provisions), whereas dividends derived from strictly non-Panama-source profits fall outside the territorial income-tax net if properly documented.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no statutory timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no surrender obligation on export receipts. A medical-device manufacturer may retain 100% of USD export proceeds in any SBP-licensed commercial bank. The only mandatory controls are documentary and AML-oriented: export customs declarations must be filed with the Dirección General de Aduanas, invoices and bills of lading must be retained in accordance with Ley 23 de 2015 record-keeping obligations, and all wire transfers must carry full originator/beneficiary data under FATF Recommendation 16.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rated Medium for auxiliary settlement and Low for primary treasury holding. Panamanian banking law (Decreto Ley 9 de 1998, as amended) reserves deposit-taking business for banks licensed by the SBP; unlicensed offshore fintech EMIs and digital banks (e.g., US or UK e-money platforms) have no statutory standing to operate a regulated Panamanian corporate account. They may be used only as ancillary collection or vendor-payment conduits, provided funds are swept daily to an SBP-licensed master account. Overreliance on an EMI creates CRS/FATCA reporting misalignment, economic-substance audit risk, and exclusion from LC-based trade finance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, Panamanian banks demand at least one physical KYC interview conducted at the bank's Panama branch, attended by a signatory director, the legal representative holding a notarized power of attorney, or another qualified officer. Fully remote opening for a Sociedad Anónima with non-resident beneficial owners is almost universally declined, although some tier-1 institutions accept video-KYC if combined with couriered apostilled documents, notarized corporate resolutions, and a subsequent in-person visit within 90 days. Standard mandates require original passports, the apostilled Certificate of Incorporation, the notarized registered-agent certificate, the operative Corporate Aviso ('Aviso de Operación' tax registration), the Libro de Acciones and Libro de Actas (share and minute books), and a clean-source-of-funds declaration from each shareholder above 10%.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore-pattern UBO: non-resident shareholders holding a Panama S.A. with no demonstrable local substance, nominee directors, or optional 'mantenimiento de sede' corporate services.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Substance package: apostilled articles of incorporation; SBP-licensed resident agent certificate; notarized board minutes evidencing actual management decisions (manufacturing plans, distributor approvals, purchase orders); local payroll records; Panama payroll and Social Security filings; warehouse or factory lease in an operational zone (e.g., Panama Pacífico or Marbella); utility invoices; MINSA sanitary registration for medical devices; and filed Form 111-A/141-A tax returns showing commercial activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverifiable source of initial capital injection or mismatch between declared share capital and incoming wire.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital-formation file: notarized share-subscription ledger; board capital-increase resolution; source-of-wealth documentation for each subscriber (three months of personal bank statements, prior business-sale agreement, audited financial statements, or inheritance deed); SWIFT MT103/MT202 referencing the corporate capital resolution with purpose code GFSR or CAPT; and a signed letter of explanation from the UBO's originating bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-lane inconsistency: surgical endoscope export invoices, bills of lading, and customs declarations that do not match the ISIC 3250 / NAICS 339112 manufacturing scope or name shell-type distributors.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial-chain package: signed distribution agreements and pro-forma invoices with registered hospitals or licensed distributors; ocean or air waybills; Panama export customs declarations; ISO 13485 quality-management certificate; CE marking under EU MDR 2017/745; FDA establishment registration for US export if applicable; and e-KYC documentation on the ultimate buyer, including its beneficial-ownership register.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Regulatory red flag: medical-device manufacturing without MINSA sanitary registration, or import/export authorization that is inconsistent with the declared operational profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Health-authority compliance bundle: MINSA medical-device registration and certificate of free sale (Decreto Ejecutivo No. 595 de 2017); import/export permits issued by Panama Customs; sterilization, quality-control, and traceability procedural documents; product bilaterals and technical files for the 4K rigid endoscopy towers; and evidence of compliance with the ISIC/NAICS classification in all corporate filings and invoices.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing: originating bank of the UBO → New York correspondent (e.g., JPMorgan Chase, Citi, or Standard Chartered) → SBP-licensed Panama beneficiary bank → the S.A.'s USD operational account. SWIFT MT103/MT202 must include full originator and beneficiary name, address, and account details (FATF Recommendation 16) together with the Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference (UETR). The wire message should cite purpose code GFSR or CAPT and reference the notarized corporate resolution authorizing the capital subscription. No central-bank authorization or exchange-control license is required; the receiving bank will perform an AML name-screen, request a source-of-funds declaration, and apply ordinary client due diligence. Funds are available immediately in USD subject to the bank's internal hold period.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 in USD for settlement of supplier invoices, intercompany services, and distributor commission payments, each with correct purpose code (e.g., GDS for trade in goods) and UETR; (2) Commercial documentary Letters of Credit (UCP 600) for high-value shipments of 4K laparoscopy towers to Latin American and Caribbean distributors, opened by the buyer's bank and confirmed by a Panama or New York bank, payable against full original documentation (commercial invoice, packed list, bill of lading, MINSA certificate, and inspection certificates); (3) domestic dollar clearing through Panama's local ACH infrastructure for payroll, rent, and domestic logistics providers; and (4) direct correspondent-bank transfers to suppliers in Asia and Europe via the issuing bank's nostro accounts. All outbound disbursements must be archived with underlying invoices, customs declarations, and delivery confirmations for at least ten years under Ley 23 de 2015 AML retention rules.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla deliverable forwards (USD/EUR, USD/CNY, USD/JPY) executed with SBP-licensed or OECD-headquartered dealer banks, limited to documented import commitments for endoscope optics, sensors, and electronics, with tenors matching underlying trade receivables and margin collaterals of 5-15%; speculative positions strictly prohibited.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in USD/COP, USD/BRL, and USD/MXN booked offshore under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement to hedge Latin American distributor receivables where local currency convertibility or transferability restrictions exist; notional strictly tied to approved export forecasts.

Cross-currency swaps (USD vs EUR, USD vs CNY, USD vs JPY) with a maximum tenor of 24 months, executed under bilateral ISDA/CSA documentation with licensed international dealers, used exclusively to re-denominate foreign-currency cash flows into the USD-functional-currency treasury pool; no embedded leverage or barrier-feature derivatives permitted.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Tasa Única / Impuesto Anual de las Sociedades) payment and filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance, Republic of Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing and payment window runs from 1 March through 30 April of each calendar year; fees are B/.300 for share capital up to USD 10,000, B/.500 for capital between USD 10,001 and USD 100,000, and B/.800 for capital exceeding USD 100,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers a sliding surcharge of 10% of the unpaid tax if settled within three months after the deadline, 20% if settled within six months, and 30% thereafter; non-payment for three consecutive fiscal years empowers DGI to place the company in delinquency and the Registro Público to proceed with administrative strike-off and loss of good standing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Reconfirmation (Confirmación Anual de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGI Beneficial Ownership Register (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales), administered online through the resident agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Reconfirmed each year on or before 30 April in parallel with the Tasa Única payment; any share transfer or change of control must be filed within 30 days of the transaction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission, late update, or false data is subject to administrative fines and suspension of the company's DGI electronic taxpayer account; unresolved delinquency blocks issuance of the solvency certificate (paz y salvo) and may invalidate reliance on the shareholder registry in notarial and registry transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Renta / ISR), including zero-income filing for inactive S.A.s
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGI E-Tax / TAT (Sistema TAT) online portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year S.A.s, no later than 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a surcharge of 10% of the resulting tax plus late interest at the Panamanian legal rate; non-filing for two consecutive periods allows DGI to assess tax on an estimated basis and to impose penalties of up to 50% of the net omitted tax; persistent non-filing also blocks the company's good-standing certificate.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent external audit by a Panamanian licensed CPA is mandatory for (i) securities issuers registered with the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores, (ii) banks, insurers, financial, trust, and fiduciary licensees of any size, and (iii) other corporations with annual gross income equal to or greater than USD 2,000,000 or total assets equal to or greater than USD 3,000,000. The target surgical laparoscopy tower manufacturer is not automatically audit-mandated until such threshold is met.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Panama applies IFRS as issued by the IASB; non-public entities may adopt IFRS for SMEs. Financial accounts are kept in USD/Balboa at parity, and statutory books and tax computations must reconcile to the chosen accounting framework.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 70 of 2018 and DGI Resolution 201-6540, the S.A., through its resident agent, must maintain and electronically file the ultimate beneficial ownership schedule in the DGI Beneficial Ownership Registry. The record is updated within 30 calendar days of any share transfer or change of control and is positively reconfirmed each year together with the Tasa Única payment, with the annual deadline falling on 30 April. Supporting identification documents and legal-entity structure charts must be retained by the resident agent for all legal shareholders and natural-person UBOs.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Share transfer ledger and UBO supporting records kept with resident agent

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 – 1,000 per year for resident agent, registered office, franchise-tax administration, and UBO registry handling
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – 4,500 per year for a standard statutory audit performed by a Panamanian CPA firm under IFRS for SMEs; group consolidated audits are higher

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial regime: only Panama-source income is taxable. Export manufacturing profits derived from sales of goods outside Panama may qualify for 100% exemption under Colon Free Zone or Panama Pacifico regimes, or the SEM (Sede de Empresas Multinacionales, Ley 41 de 2007) preferential rate of 0% to 5% for qualifying regional headquarters. Accelerated depreciation is available for high-tech biomedical machinery with DGI prior approval. No sub-national corporate income taxes exist.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 100 (Declaración Jurada de Impuesto sobre la Renta para Personas Jurídicas) filed via the DGI electronic portal e-Tax (Sistema e-Tributación de la Dirección General de Ingresos, MEF).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, supplemented by quarterly provisional ISR payments (April, July, October, and January) for taxpayers with taxable income exceeding the legal threshold.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months following the fiscal year-end. For calendar-year taxpayers the return must be filed by 31 March; non-calendar fiscal years require DGI authorization.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ingresos brutos de fuente panameña (gross Panama-source revenue from sales of endoscopy towers, spare parts, and after-sale services delivered or used within Panama).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident seller with no Panama permanent establishment must report only Panama-source revenue; revenue from foreign buyers of manufactured hardware is excluded from Box 1 and reported as exempt foreign-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ingresos exentos (exempt income): export proceeds from laparoscopy towers manufactured in Panama and sold to foreign hospital distributors, plus foreign-source service income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exempt treatment requires documentary evidence of export customs filings (export invoices, bills of lading, and foreign bank receipts). No foreign-source income clause is needed because Panama uses territorial taxation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Renta neta gravable (taxable net income): Box 1 less allowable deductions under Código Fiscal Art. 702, including cost of goods sold, depreciation, salaries, and technical expenses, with no deduction for foreign taxes paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions must be directly attributable to Panama-source business. Transfer pricing adjustments under Decree 234 of 2018 are reversed/added back at this line if the prior-year TP report was disregarded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: ISR causado (corporate income tax liability) computed at 25% of Box 3; a lower rate applies only to qualifying SEM or free-zone licensees computing tax on the preferential export base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entities not engaged in Panama-source trade may enter zero and annex the territorial treaty exemption statement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Pagos provisionales trimestrales acreditables (credit for quarterly advance ISR prepayments) and withholding credits for Panama-source dividends-receivable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credits are allowed only where the DGI clearing voucher (Formulario 105) accompanies the return; overpaid tax triggers refund with statutory interest.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaración informativa de transacciones con partes relacionadas: mandatory annex disclosing each controlled transaction (exports, intercompany royalties, management fees, and financial balances) and the selected arm's-length methodology.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-parent counterparties without a Panama PE must be identified by Tax ID and DTA residency; a zero-value annex must still be filed when a Panama taxpayer has controlled transactions below the documentary threshold.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: automatic surcharge of 1% of the tax due for each month or fraction, capped at 25%, plus a minimum fine of USD 250 and maximum fine of USD 5,000. Late payment: monthly interest at 1%. Failure to file the transfer-pricing annex: penalty of 2% of the controlled transactions, capped at USD 250,000. Non-filing for more than six months may trigger criminal tax evasion charges, asset embargoes, and suspension of the Aviso de Operación.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 5% statutory dividend withholding tax on gross distributions paid, credited, or made available by a Panamanian S.A. to its shareholders, applied by the corporation as withholding agent. Where the distributed profits have not borne the 25% corporate ISR, a 10% rate applies. Distributions among Panamanian corporations from already-taxed profits may be exempt under the territorial system.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a Panama Double Tax Agreement (DTA) at the source: (i) the foreign shareholder must obtain an official Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the competent foreign tax authority; (ii) the shareholder must submit a DTA relief self-declaration (Solicitud de Aplicación de Tratado) to the Panamanian withholding agent before the payment date; (iii) the withholding agent attaches the TRC, self-declaration, and shareholding-history evidence to the DGI annual withholding return; and (iv) documentation must be maintained for six years. Panama's active DTA network includes the Netherlands, Mexico, Spain, Italy, France, the UK, the UAE, Singapore, South Korea, India, and Switzerland; absent a valid TRC, the statutory 5% or 10% Panama rate applies in full.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory Panama-source withholding tax of 12.5% on gross payments to non-residents for the use of intangible property within Panama; treaty rates generally range from 0% to 10%. Interest: interest paid to foreign banks on external structured financing or to unrelated arm's-length lenders is typically exempt under territorial sourcing rules; interest on related-party loans funding Panama operations is subject to a 12.5% statutory WHT (25% if the lender carries on a Panama PE), with treaty rates commonly 0% for bank-to-corporate debt.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD (Panama Balboa/USD legal tender at par). Mandatory Local File: aggregate controlled transactions exceeding USD 1,000,000 per fiscal year. Mandatory Master File: group consolidated revenue exceeding USD 20,000,000. A full transfer-pricing report (Local + Master) plus benchmarking study is required when controlled transactions exceed USD 2,000,000. The Form 100 Anexo TP annex is mandatory for any controlled transaction value exceeding USD 250,000, irrespective of the documentation threshold.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Regulations (Ley 116 de 2019 and Executive Decree 291 of 2019) apply to entities licensed in Panama carrying out 'relevant activities' (banking, financing, leasing, headquartering, distribution and logistics, shipping, IP holding, insurance, etc.). Manufacturing of surgical laparoscopy towers (ISIC 3250) is not enumerated as a relevant activity and therefore falls outside the ESR reporting matrix. Nevertheless, the S.A. must maintain substantive local operations, including a physical office or factory, qualified employees, production records, and the mandatory Aviso de Operación / industrial license, to preserve territorial tax exemptions and treaty access and to avoid being recharacterized as a 'shell entity' under Panama's beneficial-ownership framework.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately underreporting Panama local sales of endoscopy towers, fabricating export-bill trail documents to shift profit to a foreign affiliated distributor, or destroying production and sales records to avoid the 25% ISR.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Restitution of the omitted ISR with a 25% to 50% surcharge plus 1% monthly interest; closure of business license; criminal tax fraud conviction under the Código Penal (defraudación fiscal) carrying imprisonment of 2 to 5 years and a fine of up to 50 times the monthly national minimum wage; administrative embargo of bank accounts and goods.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and general managers who signed false returns or arranged sham export documentation are held jointly and severally liable (responsabilidad solidaria) for the resulting tax debt; courts may issue travel bans (prohibición de salida), freeze personal assets, and impose custodial sentences; the corporate veil is pierced for fraud under the Código Judicial.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Panama S.A. with no physical factory, no employees, no local production records, and no Aviso de Operación, while claiming territorial exemptions, treaty benefits, or free-zone status for the laparoscopy tower export activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disregard of the legal entity with retroactive re-allocation of all manufacturing profits to the foreign parent; denial of treaty relief; revocation of the S.A.'s taxpayer registration; economic substance levies and penalties under Panama's ESR framework; inclusion in the DGI 'shell entity' risk register leading to automatic CRS exchange.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally taxed on any distributions received, fined up to USD 100,000 for false corporate declarations, and banned from serving on any Panamanian board for up to 5 years; asset freezes and travel bans apply in flagrant abuse cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation and False Documentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting manipulated TNMM comparables, issuing inflated intercompany invoices for 'engineering support', or making year-end transfer-pricing adjustments that shift taxable profit out of Panama without contemporaneous documentation or an arm's-length benchmarking study.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authority re-determination of the taxpayer's profit using the most appropriate OECD or statutory method; deficiency assessment of 25% plus a 30% valuation penalty; interest at 1% per month; public disclosure of the offender's name in the DGI audit list; criminal penalties for filing fraudulent TP documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Finnancial directors who approved the TP policy are jointly liable for the assessed deficiency up to the amount of profit shifted; in cases of document forgery, directors face imprisonment of 3 to 6 years and disqualification from corporate management; international exchange of information exposes them to parallel prosecution in treaty-partner states.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the Registro de Beneficiario Final (Law 129 of 2013 and its amendments) with the IFAR, accepting payments through anonymous third-party wire transfers for laparoscopy tower exports without customer due diligence (CDD), or using bearer-share structures ahead of Year 2022 without immobilization.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary fines from USD 500 up to USD 2,000,000 per violation imposed by the Financial Analysis Unit (UAF) or the applicable supervisory body; 30% surcharges on unpaid taxes; possible suspension of banking licenses and the industrial operating license; criminal money-laundering charges under the Código Penal with imprisonment of 5 to 12 years for habitual non-compliance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers are personally liable for AML breaches, unrelated to any tax obligation: travel bans are routinely issued during UAF investigations; personal bank accounts and property are attachable; imprisonment for up to 5 years applies to directors who knowingly collected or laundered proceeds from export transactions involving sanctioned end-customers.
